description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayBootstrapAuth component in the Android app, verifying authentication logic, session handling, TLS handshake responses, and user prompts related to gateway trust.

classes.name: GatewayBootstrapAuthTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for gateway authentication and connection logic within the Android app.

methods.name: skipsOperatorSessionWhenOnlyBootstrapAuthExists
methods.description: Test that verifies the operator session is skipped when only bootstrap authentication is present.

methods.name: connectsOperatorSessionWhenSharedPasswordOrStoredAuthExists
methods.description: Test that verifies connection occurs when shared password or stored auth exists.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthUsesStoredTokenPathAfterBootstrapHandoff
methods.description: Test that resolves the operator session auth using the stored token after bootstrap handoff.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthPrefersExplicitSharedAuth
methods.description: Test that prefers explicit shared authentication over other options.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectAuth_prefersExplicitSetupAuthOverStoredPrefs
methods.description: Test that setup auth explicitly set by the user takes precedence over stored preferences.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt_preservesExplicitSetupAuth
methods.description: Test that acceptance of the gateway trust prompt preserves explicit setup authentication.

methods.name: connect_showsSecureEndpointGuidanceWhenTlsProbeFails
methods.description: Test that shows guidance message when TLS handshake fails and connectivity is compromised.

methods.name: waitForGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Helper function to wait until the gateway trust prompt appears.

methods.name: waitForStatusText
methods.description: Helper function to wait until the status text updates from the initial prompt.

methods.name: desiredBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token from the specified session field within the runtime using reflection.

methods.name: readField
methods.description: Utility function that reads a field via reflection from an object.
